item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q001_histone_related_proteins","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, the histone relationship is represented as `a` class, `All alpha proteins` -> `a.22` fold, `Histone-fold` -> `a.22.1` superfamily, `Histone-fold`. The fold and superfamily have the same text label here, but the biologically strong statement is the superfamily placement: SCOPe marks homology as implied for `a.22.1`, so its families are treated as homologous histone-fold proteins, not merely proteins with an all-alpha architecture. The canonical eukaryotic nucleosome histones are the separate family `a.22.1.1`, `Nucleosome core histones`, which SCOPe further subdivides into H2A, H2B, H3, H4, the macro-H2A.1 histone domain, and automated matches. The other named families in that same histone-fold superfamily are `a.22.1.2`, `Archaeal histone`; `a.22.1.3`, `TBP-associated factors, TAFs`, containing histone-fold transcription/chromatin subunits such as CHRAC-14/CHRAC-16, NC2 alpha/beta, NF-YB/NF-YC, several TAF(II) histone-fold domains, and the Son-of-sevenless histone domain; and `a.22.1.4`, `Bacterial histone-fold protein`, containing Aq_328 and TTHA1479-like proteins. SCOPe also has `a.22.1.0`, `automated matches`, under the same superfamily; those are not a manually named functional family. The limit is therefore family-scale: archaeal histones, TAF/NC2/NF-Y-type histone-fold domains, and bacterial histone-fold proteins are homologous to nucleosome core histones at the `a.22.1` superfamily/fold level, but they are outside the `a.22.1.1` nucleosome-core-histone family, so nucleosome octamer roles or a specific H2A/H2B/H3/H4 identity should not be transferred to them just from this classification.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope.get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47113, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47113/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47113/homology","mcp__scope.list_scop_children: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a.22.1/children?limit=100","mcp__scope.list_scop_children: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47114/children?limit=100","mcp__scope.list_scop_children: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47129/children?limit=100","mcp__scope.list_scop_children: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47134/children?limit=100","mcp__scope.list_scop_children: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/101318/children?limit=100","mcp__scope.list_scop_children: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/238448/children?limit=100"]}]}
